context.requirement_text: Run REQ-205's harness against SwiftRoute's 4 scenario YAMLs. 6 tests in req206_swiftroute_test.exs.

task.description: Independently verify that test/letflow/simulation/req206_swiftroute_test.exs covers all 6 acceptance criteria for REQ-206. Do NOT rely on TEST-DESIGNER's mapping — read the test file yourself and map each test to its AC. Run mix test test/letflow/simulation/req206_swiftroute_test.exs independently and quote the output. Verify: (1) each of AC1..AC6 has a test, (2) no test is always-pass (has a genuine FAIL condition), (3) AC2's high-value-happy test asserts all 4 expected_outcomes with real queried state, (4) AC3's ops-timeout-escalation test asserts step 2 outcome :skip with severity :minor, (5) AC4's attach-delivery-note test asserts disposition :unbuilt_feature with zero steps executed. Return PASS or FAIL.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 ACs independently verified with specific test names and assertion evidence
mix test output quoted from a live run
